title: The Unmarked Turning

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The month goes out as a fire goes out — by degrees, and with nobody calling the hour. What the kiln took in Ember it does not give back in Grain. The coat on the peg keeps the shape it was left, and the seat keeps the hollow. Go around the line. Leave the crack showing. The river is not asked, and the fifth pull has no name.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail kiln-house at the turning into Grain

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and ten to two hundred and twelve days, six months and thirty days to six months and thirty-two days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing (the private file turned out as instruments on a towel, a cost asked as a direction answered with the pot and the weather, the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost, dusty forearms and clean ones parted as a field from the instruments that must not touch it, an inch asked of a small hand under a roof the market cannot enter) without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line — the old life stays offstage — and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector or back-room interior, no new hearing beyond six, no seventh, no tenth stopping before the seventh year is earned and still not given, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no third telling of the shut counting room, no seventh green or seventh sighting of the foundling, no opening, no calling of the loan, no payer named, no private record read and no ending

scenes.title: Grain Comes On in the Dark
scenes.synopsis: First entry, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 210, Grain 1, Firstday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning. The hand lies down against the fold after the miss of the night before, and the miss is not recalled as a sign. The boy is two hundred and ten days old and six months and thirty days, told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for two hundred and ten days (T088); through a finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water, a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings, and overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — three counts in three places that do not become one, because agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. One leathery brown-edged crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool is frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting on a warming nobody in this house will perform. The file is laid out as instruments on a towel: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Ember's third reading gone up the clay road in Berr's locked box and still not the figure paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year is earned and now at its very end, three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth, the held inch on a sixth, the burned-slate word on its own place beside Jorra's dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three, and the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place on trays that do not touch. Grain comes on in the dark beyond the door as Ember came on before it, with no mark at the turning; there is no market and no Account-day in these three days, Grain 10 (Day 219) being the first. Sella comes to the fire before the basket and gives the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom, the running water and the river wind and never to the basket; the house, half-pace, jar-glance and hand shut half over nothing without a touch, lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, finger kept on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T058/T079, T100). A neighbour's cost-question at the door goes to the pot and the weather and goes away level, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying though the paying stands in the ruts, keeps the knife at the very edge of its sill with six counted where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot and Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops with no figure and no name, leaves nine stoppings nine, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, sweeps past the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without turning, and no collector comes (T036/T076). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and under the nails, not bone-coloured slip, parts dust from slip as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, gives no name to the men who went low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey, speaks to the wheel before anyone, tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note three turns ahead and withholds it from a man on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stays a saying and costs no pot, and holds his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot — a remembered repetition, not a change made again (T035/T031/T062, T061/T082, T065/T095). Asked in the morning, the hand goes up an inch toward the note and comes down before the counted breath has finished, filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Shape a House Keeps
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 210, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and the hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending and heat goes off the high air first and stays longest under the shelf, behind the pot and in the fold where one leathery crust keeps its empty place unnamed and no third comes; the underside of the shelf makes a roof that stops where his hand stops, and the warmth comes down that roof in a slow slant and stops at the same edge. Garl is kept in objects and not in a story at the turning of the month: the salt-stiff coat holds a broader man's shape with the crease at the left shoulder, the seat keeps its twenty-year leftward lean and hollow, the clean dark line and the new finer hairline of grey called the thaw lie unswept, the proverb about leaving the crack showing has gone to the pot, and the debt against a firing of tiles is circled without a name, worse for being uncalled because it can neither be paid nor settled nor stopped; no lesson made, no collector called, the name unspoken for two hundred and ten days (T009/T013/T092). Sella stands with her back to the basket, moves her lips along a row standing with two unnamed gaps and gives nobody a figure, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, uncounted and uncopied, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, stands counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, lets her hand rest a half-beat longer than the setting requires and does not look toward the bed (T058/T079, T100). The widow's mark hangs where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no shelf, hearth, well, rack, road, basket, yard, market, morning, afternoon or dusk since — no opening in thirty days — and her private roll stays unshown while Dessa's cost stays unentered. Tarn brings the ear-sentence to the threshold of the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, draws the breath he should have spent and does not spend it, leaves nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year is earned and now at its very end and not given, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, sweeps the collector's road without turning and no collector comes; the warm stone lies cold and unreconciled in its unmarked pot in the Debt Loft and the small loft-sill scrape stays on its fourth place (T036/T076, T006). Jorra keeps the burned-slate word on a place of its own beside the dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three and makes no cause of it, enters none of the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack, keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray, tells a pot You'll do, withholds its note from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stays a saying, and holds his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition — one piece of iron with two bites, no Grathic word for both mercies, joined to no kiln and entered in no slate; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates stays ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). At the going of the light Sella carries him home at the half-pace, woodsmoke before her in long low bars and river wind behind with the taste of water over water, going wide around the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather, the rack space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number; the carrying arm is a record in muscle that remembers weight and not cost (T009/T013/T092/T098). Under the roof she sets him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread frozen; the two rooms do not touch, the fire going on in the room that warms him and the river in the room he cannot enter, and neither stopping for the ear under the roof. In the small hours he turns out the file and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing, then the hand goes up an inch toward the note, holds for the small intake only and comes down before the letting go, filed on its sixth place beside the others and laid across nothing — not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, key, power or rule (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The First Tending of Grain
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 211, Grain 2, Secondday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the drying racks and the edge of the clay road. New day, new date, no recap: the boy is two hundred and eleven days old and six months and thirty-one days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth is unpaid for two hundred and eleven days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places that do not become one (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap. The firing thins into the ordinary tending of a year begun: the yard goes around the clean dark line, the new finer grey called the thaw, the rack space under the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098). At the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asks what the new month's pots will want now the firing is done; Sella sends her to the pot and the weather and the question goes away level, nothing priced, refused or entered, and a man off the clay road keeps a number shut in his fist and pays nothing (T077). Berr's box stayed locked up the road with Ember's third subtraction inside, the printed one in twelve stands unchallenged, Hessa's slate lies unread at Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, all held offstage in the boy's file and none of them opened or reached back (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). Sella's instruction goes to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom, the running water and the river wind and never to the basket; the house, half-pace, jar-glance without a touch, lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, finger kept from beneath the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a morning shelf and a well are not openings (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count and says Yes, house to the early thaw and the late while keeping the late because it puts off the paying; six stand where the house can check and the seventh waits at the lip where it cannot, the knife at the very edge of its sill with the unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops with no figure and no name, the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the loan uncalled, and no collector on the road (T036/T076). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and under the nails, not bone-coloured slip, parts dust from slip as clot from vessel, keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray, gives the men who went into the back room before first grey no name, keeps the burned-slate word a direction arrived nowhere on its own place with no third telling of the shut counting room and no joining to the dust or the back room, speaks to the wheel before anyone, tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note three turns ahead and withholds it from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stays a saying, and holds his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T065/T095, T062). Asked in the morning, the hand goes up an inch toward the note and comes down at once — the asking is not always answered and there is no failure in the miss — filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Second Day Did Not Enter
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 211, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and the hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending and heat settles in the low places under the shelf, behind the pot and in the fold where one brown-edged crust lies stiff and leathery two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread at his mouth is frozen and unwiped, cold has stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waits on the far side of a warming nobody in this house will perform. Sella stands with her back to the basket, moves her lips along a row with two unnamed gaps and gives nobody a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, tells the fire it is the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, and sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark is untouched at an afternoon and a dusk, for neither is an opening and there has been no opening since before the kiln on Ember 1 — no opening in thirty-one days (T058/T079, T100). Garl is kept in objects through the second day of Grain: the coat keeps a broader shape, the seat its hollow and leftward lean, the clean dark line and the finer grey unswept, the proverb gone to the pot and the debt against the tiles neither paid nor settled nor named, with no lesson and no collector and the name unspoken for two hundred and eleven days (T009/T013/T092). Tarn brings the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, draws the breath he should have spent and does not spend it, sweeps past the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector without once turning along it, leaves nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year is earned and now at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, and no collector comes up or goes down the clay road; the warm stone lies cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra keeps the burned-slate word beside the dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three and makes no cause of it, parts dust from slip as clot from vessel, tells a pot You'll do, withholds the knowing of its full note from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stays a saying and costs no pot, keeps he's not Vail sealed and the promise of the boy's name ungiven, and when Sella's voice goes low and unfinished at the hearth his bent finger goes into the cold iron of the damper ahead of her hand and holds until the sentence reaches feeding, then moves the tongue a hair's breadth and leaves the finger standing — a remembered holding and not a change made again, the iron one piece with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, joined to no kiln and entered in no slate (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). At the going of the light Sella carries him home around the pan's gone ring, the bare dark trough, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, and sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, fold right without a look at his face and thread left frozen; the carried fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for two hundred and eleven days, the river keeps its note through the finger's-width door and the boards keep four nails, four and a knot (T088, T061/T082, T009/T013/T092/T098). In the small hours Sella has gone to her own bed and left the coals to keep themselves and there is no breathing number anywhere in the house, only the rhythm through the door; the file is found exact, complete and worth nothing, and then the hand goes up an inch toward the note of water over water and stays for the length of the river's own low interval and comes down on the river's next low note — the one-rhythm coordination remembered, not a change made again — filed on its sixth place and laid across nothing (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Third Day of the New Tending
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 212, Grain 3, Thirdday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the edge of the clay road. New day, new date, no recap: the boy is two hundred and twelve days old and six months and thirty-two days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth is unpaid for two hundred and twelve days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places that do not become one (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap. Grain's first tend runs on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two month-names is corrected; there is no market and no Account-day until Grain 10 (Day 219). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the new finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough and the field's empty place with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098). Sella gives the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom, the running water and the river wind and never to the basket, says the house, keeps the half-pace, glances once at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, moves her lips along a two-gapped row and gives nobody a figure, keeps her finger from beneath the charcoal, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaves the widow's mark untouched at a shelf and a morning because neither is an opening and there has been no opening in thirty-two days (T058/T079, T100). A neighbour at the door with a cost-question about the new month's work is sent to the pot and the weather and goes away level, nothing priced or entered (T077). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count with the knife at the very edge of its sill, six counted where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot and Garl's unforged sentence beside it; he says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late and keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying though the paying has stood in the ruts since the water went; chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops with no figure and no name, the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still not given, the loan uncalled, his stroke over the flagstones past the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn, and no collector came (T036/T076). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and under the nails, not bone-coloured slip, keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray, parts dust from slip as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, gives no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, keeps the burned-slate word a direction arrived nowhere beside the dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three and no third telling, speaks to the wheel before anyone, tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note three turns before it leaves the wheel and withholds it from a man on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stays a saying and costs no pot; before Sella has finished telling him the fire is low his bent finger goes into the cold damper and holds until the sentence reaches the pot, then moves the tongue a hair's breadth and leaves it standing, a remembered repetition, the iron one piece with two bites joined to no kiln and entered in no slate; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name stays ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095). Asked in the morning, the hand goes up an inch toward the note, holds for the small intake only and comes down before the letting go, filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

Then he puts the question to his hand.
